claims.sentence: Singleton pregnancies being diagnosed of fetal growth restriction from 24 to 32.6 weeks of gestation will be randomized to two equally sized groups: maternal oral supplementation with Lactoferrin and DHA (Docosahexaenoic acid) or placebo.
